method: Actual running UI operated through the in-app browser; screenshots were captured and visually inspected. Deterministic and real-model projects are identified separately.

surfaces.purpose: Explicit deterministic demo and controlled failure acceptance
Actual DSH model, story direction choice, extraction and final delivery

checks.actions: Created the original demo; generated chapter one; took over, changed copper key to silver key; observed a save failure during the owned local server outage; restarted, retried, verified saved revision 5 and reload; generated chapter two with a Context Trace referencing the author version.

Edited character aliases/voice and a world rule; edited the relationship with asymmetric participant knowledge. After final restart, the SVG group exposes two character buttons and a relationship button; clicking the edge opens the corresponding populated editor.

Selected body text, previewed an AI Diff and accepted only selected replacement text, keeping outside content. Adopted an Inbox idea into an empty future chapter, accepted a scoped replan and undid it; author plan restored at revision 3 without canon changes.

Explicitly fault-injected deterministic key-holder conflict. UI displayed both sources and located the conflicting line. Took over the candidate, replaced the local holder sentence, re-reviewed and accepted the repaired chapter; the invalid older artifact remains stale.

Uploaded original test/fixtures/import-story.md, adjusted first chapter title in split preview and confirmed both chapters. Verified raw import byte-for-byte via API. Clicked Markdown and JSON attachment links and observed browser download events; uploaded a saved response from that same backup API via file chooser and opened restored version history. Browser download-directory bytes were not inspected.

Opened actual DSH first chapter in Writer and second-chapter completed task in Director. Verified current model, persisted stages, source versions, real artifacts and collapsed new-task composer. New task and Writer delegation reopen the composer.

In actual DSH UI selected alternate direction B and accepted its newly generated setup. Accepted both real chapter extraction artifacts; all 15 extracted objects remain source-linked uncertain candidates for author confirmation.

Desktop Writer/Director and narrow window navigation/auxiliary drawers checked; light/dark controls used. Fixed the narrow header overlap and retained actionable drawers. Final temporary viewport overrides reset and standalone testing tab closed.
